title: Titanium Endoscope Sheath
alloyReason: Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V (UNS R56320) is specified for this surgical instruments application needing intermediate strength between CP and Ti-6Al-4V with superior cold formability. Its 620 MPa tensile with 20% elongation provides 30% weight reduction vs steel. This rationale is driven by rigid endoscope outer protective sheath and fat life requirements.
process: CNC swiss turning for surgical instruments geometry
Ultrasonic clean Class 10k for net-shape tolerance
surfaceTreatment: Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for rigid endoscope outer application
commonFailures: Fatigue fracture at thread root under cyclic bending - resolved by thread rolling (not cutting) for compressive stress — critical for rigid endoscope outer performance

faq.q: What specific material properties make Titanium Endoscope Sheath suitable for Rigid endoscope outer protective sheath?
faq.a: Titanium Endoscope Sheath uses Grade 9 Ti-3Al-2.5V because its yield strength, fatigue endurance, and corrosion resistance directly address surgical instruments operational demands. The alloy's specific strength enables mass reduction without section compromise, while the TiO2 passivation ensures long-term environmental resistance.

faq.q: What are the critical dimensional tolerances for Titanium Endoscope Sheath?
faq.a: Standard machining tolerance for Titanium Endoscope Sheath is +/-0.05mm (ISO 2768-m). Functional mating surfaces are held to +/-0.025mm with Ra 0.8um finish, verified specifically for rigid endoscope outer requirements. Threaded features conform to ISO 965-2 Class 6g, verified with calibrated Go/No-Go ring gauges on 100% of production.

faq.q: Does Titanium Endoscope Sheath require any post-machining surface treatment?
faq.a: Yes. rigid endoscope outer components require Electropolishing + passivation per ASTM F86 (20-30% HNO3, 30min @50C) achieving Ra <0.2um for implant-grade finish — tailored for rigid endoscope outer application. This restores the natural TiO2 passive layer removed during machining and provides the required surface properties for the specific service environment. Key parameters include surface finish Ra 0.8um and passive layer thickness verification per applicable standards.

faq.q: What quality documentation is included with Titanium Endoscope Sheath shipments?
faq.a: Each shipment of Titanium Endoscope Sheath includes: (1) EN 10204 Type 3.1 MTR with full chemical analysis and mechanical properties; (2) Certificate of Conformance confirming all processes meet rigid endoscope outer specifications; (3) Dimensional inspection report with actual vs nominal measurements on critical features; (4) Surface roughness certification per applicable standards. FAIR available on request.

faq.q: What is the MOQ and typical lead time for Endoscope tube / Laparoscope sheath surgical instruments components?
faq.a: Standard MOQ: 1 unit for prototype evaluation. Production lead time: 15-25 business days depending on quantity. Rush orders (3-5 days) available. Contact our supply chain team for volume-based tiered pricing.
